title: joint personnel and equipment demand

resource_policy.step_scope: resources are acquired and released per step
resource_policy.joint_acquisition: SERVICE acquires both resources or neither
resource_policy.blocked_service: INSPECT resources have already been released and SERVICE holds no partial lease

native_mapping.mapping_note: SubTaskResource is authoritative for this contract; TaskResource must be empty unless a separately versioned native probe proves required inheritance; each ResourceAllocation.POINT must equal Control.APID (AIR_BASIC)

failure.message: All required resources are not available at station (STID): BASE-01

source_evidence.excerpt: APID: Allocation Point Identifier; related fields include ResourceAllocation POINT
source_evidence.native_comparator: working J35 probe has Control.APID=J35 and every ResourceAllocation.POINT=J35

failed_candidate_revisions.diagnosis: the failed inputs used Control.APID=AIR_BASIC but ResourceAllocation.POINT=AIR-TYPE
failed_candidate_revisions.retention_rule: retain every v1.0.0 input and hash as immutable failed evidence; never select it for acceptance

expected_assertions.assert: INSPECT uses one P-CREW during [450,460) and releases it at 460
SERVICE uses one P-CREW and one E-GSE together during [460,480)
both-available releases both SERVICE leases at 480 before launch
equipment-zero completes INSPECT, then SERVICE waits while holding neither P-CREW nor E-GSE
the personnel-zero boundary remains deferred and is not claimed by the v1 generated candidates
main-task and subtask resource rows are not silently combined or double-counted

limitations: A successful available-capacity run alone does not prove joint acquisition under scarcity
No resource substitution or transit is modeled
